request.style: English, gentle female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, flute, harp, warm and nostalgic mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the land where Caleb walked
The sons of Jerahmeel’s kin
Mesha the firstborn stood
Father of Ziph the old hill
Hebron’s sons came forth
Korah and Tappuah there
Rekem and Shema
Roots in the southern ground

[Pre-Chorus]
From the branch of Shema
A name is clearly known
Raham was his son
Part of Judah’s line

[Chorus]
Shema fathered Raham
Raham was father of Jorkeam
The bloodline flows on
In the promised land

[Verse]
Rekem fathered Shammai
Shammai had a son
Maon was his name
Father of Beth Zur
The towns they founded
Mark the history
Of this tribe in Judah
Settled in the earth

[Chorus]
Shema fathered Raham
Raham was father of Jorkeam
The bloodline flows on
In the promised land

[Bridge]
From Hebron to the hills
The names are recorded here
A branch of Caleb’s house
Kept in the book of years

[Outro]
Raham and Jorkeam
Line of Shema stands
